description: This file defines an abstract interface class IAVBufferHelper for buffer management operations such as mapping, unmapping, copying, and size retrieval of memory buffers identified by handles. It also contains a factory function declaration to obtain an implementation of this interface.

classes.name: IAVBufferHelper
classes.description: An abstract class that provides methods for buffer management including mapping, unmapping, copying, and size querying of handles.

methods.name: mapHandle
methods.description: Maps memory from the given handle, returns a pointer to the mapped memory and its size.

methods.name: unmapHandle
methods.description: Unmaps memory associated with the given handle.

methods.name: getAllocationSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the memory allocated for the given handle.

methods.name: bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle,void * data,uint32_t size)
methods.description: Writes data into a secure buffer specified by the handle; has a default implementation returning false.

methods.name: bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo,uint64_t handleFrom,CopyMap map,uint32_t mapSize)
methods.description: Copies data between secure buffers with a specified map; has a default implementation returning false.

ctags.name: copySecureHandleWithMap
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo, uint64_t handleFrom, CopyMap map, ui/

ctags.name: writeSecureHandle
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle, void* data, uint32_t size) { return false; }$/
